title: 第5章 通天藤上的小葫芦第6章 找到阵眼挥刀就砍
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
“师姐，别费劲了。
这次，我让五尾狐布置的迷魂阵，可比上次三尾狐布置的厉害多了。
那些东西都给你俩了，树洞里还有好多吃的，够你们吃好多天了。
别想我啊，等我玩一段时间就回来。
回来时候，我多给你们带宝贝东西啊。
嘿嘿嘿，再见喽！”
落尘笑嘻嘻挥手告别。
这次五尾狐布置的迷魂阵，半个月后才能自动解封，足够他疯狂一段时间了。
至于回来关禁闭、打屁股，他才不怕。
从小到大，禁闭蹲了多少次都数不清了，屁股都被打出茧子了，啥事没有。
“小混蛋，外面大妖很多，你不要小命了，放我们出去！”
“小赖皮，千万不能碰遗迹废墟什么的，很危险！”
清婉和紫嫣大喊。
方圆三万里绝不像表面上青山绿水鸟语花香那么简单。
原本是葬神墟的核心区域，除了大妖，秘境、遗迹。
未知的存在都有，危险重重。
落尘也不知听没听到师姐的喊话，头都没回。
两个小腿一用力，纵身跳到烈焰狮背上，小手一挥，大喊一声：
“出发！”
“遵命！”

群兽应声开拔。
一个六岁的小屁孩，领着一群妖兽，浩浩荡荡冲向群山深处。
“咱们跟着去不？”
树上，大红鸟征求乌鸦和大白鹤意见。
“不去！
我才不当那小屁孩的小弟呢。”
大乌鸦回话。
“可是，真的有好宝贝啊……”
大白鹤犹豫。
“那小孩虽然凶，但是挺大方的，有功劳他真奖励。”
大红鸟实话实说。
“我觉得要是能放下面子，当他小弟也不错，起码外面那些大妖不敢动他。
“金刚猿当他小弟可以说金刚猿傻，九尾狐一族最能算计了，好像最早当他小弟的……”
“嗯，烈焰狮多威风，不也低头了……”
“可是他过几年就走了，到时候，咱们怎么办？”
“给他当小弟，这几年修炼速度一定快。
content_en:
"Sister, don't bother.
This time, the enchantment formation I asked the five-tailed fox to set up was much more powerful than the one set up by the three-tailed fox last time.
Those things are given to you two, and there is a lot of food in the tree hole, enough for you to eat for many days.
Don't miss me. I'll come back after I play for a while.
When I come back, I will bring you more precious things.
Hey hey hey, bye! "
Luochen smiled and waved goodbye.
The enchantment array arranged by the five-tailed fox this time will be automatically unblocked after half a month, which is enough for him to go crazy for a while.
As for being put in solitary confinement or spanked, he is not afraid.
Ever since I was little, I have been squatting in confinement so many times that I can’t even count. My buttocks have been cocooned, but nothing has happened.
"You little bastard, there are a lot of monsters out there. If you don't want to kill yourself, let us out!"
"You little scoundrel, don't touch ruins or anything like that, it's very dangerous!"
Qingwan and Ziyan shouted.
Thirty thousand miles in a radius is by no means as simple as green mountains, green waters, birds singing and fragrance of flowers.
It was originally the core area of ​​the God Burial Ruins, except for the big demon, the secret realm, and the ruins.
There are unknown existences, and there are many dangers.
Luochen didn't know whether he heard his senior sister's call or not, so he didn't even look back.
With two little legs, he jumped onto the back of the blazing lion, waved his little hand, and shouted:
"Let's go!"
"As you command!"
The beasts set off in response.
A six-year-old kid, leading a group of monster beasts, rushed deep into the mountains.
"Shall we follow?"
In the trees, the big red bird consults the crow and the big white crane.
"Don't go!
I don't want to be that little brat's little brother. "
The crow replied.
"But, there is really a good baby..."
The big white crane hesitated.
"Although that kid is fierce, he is very generous. He really rewards those who have merit."
The big red bird tells the truth.
"I think it would be nice to be his little brother if I could put my dignity down, at least the big monsters outside wouldn't dare to touch him.
"You can say that Diamond Ape is stupid when he considers him his younger brother. The nine-tailed fox clan is the most calculating. It seems that he was the first to become his younger brother..."
"Well, the flaming lion is so majestic, why don't you bow your head..."
“But he will be gone in a few years, what will we do then? "
"Being his little brother will definitely make you practice faster in the past few years.
